title.narrative: Reinforcing the collaboration for a better response to HIV and TB in Mozambique - Mozambique (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Mozambique, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health of Mozambique (MISAU)This program has the following goals: Reduce TB mortality (HIV Negative) from 49/100,000 persons in 2011 to 37/100,000 persons in 2017. Reduce TB/HIV mortality from 148//100,000 persons in 2013 to 126/100,000 persons in 2017. Reduce the incidence of TB from 544/100,000 persons in 2011 to 390/100,000 by 2018. Reduce the incidence of TB in HIV infected persons (by provision of IPT and ART). Reduce the mortality from HIV in TB patients (by HTC and provision of early ART to all). Reduce the mortality from TB in HIV infected persons (by ICF and early TB treatment to all with TB). The objectives of this program are: Improve the treatments success rate of patients treated for MDR-TB from 30% in 2012 (cohort 2010) to 65% in 2018. Increase case notifications of all forms of TB at a speed of 6-12% per year, from 186/100,000 at baseline in 2011 to 343/100,000 in 2018 (72% of expected cases). Increase coverage of Art for HIV positive TB patients from 72% in 2013 to 90% in 2015 and 100% in 2018. Increase the number of enrolled MDR-TB patients from 313 in 2013 to 1648 in 2018. Maintain treatment success rate for all forms of TB at 87%. Maintain uptake of CPT for HIV+ TB patients at >95%
